      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: crap4js gate (ratchet — baseline ${{ env.CRAP_THRESHOLD }})
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}"

# Pull Request Information - **PR #**: 738 - **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/738 - **Title**: gh-737 pack PR template must emit 'Closes # issue ' (merge bot can't link factory PRs) - **Author**: ai-teammate - **Branch**: `ai/gh-737` → `main` - **State**: open - **Files Changed**: 11 - **Additions**: +245 - **Deletions**: -12 - **Created**: 2026-10-05T11:44:10Z - **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:56:28Z ## PR Description Closes #737 ### What changed Added a shared `ensureClosesLine`/`extractIssueNumber` guard in `js/common/pullRequest.js` that injects the canonical `Closes #N` line (N = trailing number of the ticket key, e.g. `gh-737` → 737) into every PR body by construction, and threaded a new `ticketKey` option through `createPullRequest` and all PR-creating pack actions (`developTicketAndCreatePR`, `developBugFixBatchAndCreatePR`, `postTestAutomationResults`, `postStoryTestAutomationResults`, `postMobileTestAutomationResults`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `postTestReworkResults`, direct `scm.createPr` in `preCliTestReworkSetup`). ### Key decisions - Single choke point: injection lives in `common/pullRequest.js`, so both the gh-cli and SCM-provider paths are covered — `developBugAndCreatePR` inherits it via delegation, no change needed there - Idempotent: a body that already contains `Closes #N` for the same issue is untouched; non-canonical keywords (`Fixes`/`Part-of`, accepted bot-side via awf#19) never substitute — the pack still emits canonical `Closes` - Applied after body resolution, so even the `defaultBody` fallback (`'Development changes.'`) carries the line; keys without digits leave the body unchanged - TDD: failing tests first — helper-level cases (prepend/idempotent/Fixes-still-gets-Closes/no-digits/gh-cli/SCM/back-compat) plus an end-to-end dev-leg test asserting the written PR body contains `Closes #737` ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json ``` 1597 passed, 0 failed (includes the new gh-737 suites).

postStory/MobileTestAutomationResults] --> PRH TREV[prepareTestPRForReview
postTestReworkResults] --> PRH TRW[preCliTestReworkSetup] -->|ensureClosesLine| BODY PRH --> CLOSES[ensureClosesLine

links PR to issue] ```

# pr-738: gh-737 pack PR template must emit 'Closes # issue ' (merge bot can't link factory PRs) ## Description Closes #737 ### What changed Added a shared `ensureClosesLine`/`extractIssueNumber` guard in `js/common/pullRequest.js` that injects the canonical `Closes #N` line (N = trailing number of the ticket key, e.g. `gh-737` → 737) into every PR body by construction, and threaded a new `ticketKey` option through `createPullRequest` and all PR-creating pack actions (`developTicketAndCreatePR`, `developBugFixBatchAndCreatePR`, `postTestAutomationResults`, `postStoryTestAutomationResults`, `postMobileTestAutomationResults`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `postTestReworkResults`, direct `scm.createPr` in `preCliTestReworkSetup`). ### Key decisions - Single choke point: injection lives in `common/pullRequest.js`, so both the gh-cli and SCM-provider paths are covered — `developBugAndCreatePR` inherits it via delegation, no change needed there - Idempotent: a body that already contains `Closes #N` for the same issue is untouched; non-canonical keywords (`Fixes`/`Part-of`, accepted bot-side via awf#19) never substitute — the pack still emits canonical `Closes` - Applied after body resolution, so even the `defaultBody` fallback (`'Development changes.'`) carries the line; keys without digits leave the body unchanged - TDD: failing tests first — helper-level cases (prepend/idempotent/Fixes-still-gets-Closes/no-digits/gh-cli/SCM/back-compat) plus an end-to-end dev-leg test asserting the written PR body contains `Closes #737` ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json ``` 1597 passed, 0 failed (includes the new gh-737 suites).

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: crap4js gate (ratchet — baseline ${{ env.CRAP_THRESHOLD }})
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: crap4js gate (ratchet — baseline ${{ env.CRAP_THRESHOLD }})
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: crap4js gate (ratchet — baseline ${{ env.CRAP_THRESHOLD }})
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: crap4js gate (ratchet — baseline ${{ env.CRAP_THRESHOLD }})
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: crap4js gate (ratchet — baseline ${{ env.CRAP_THRESHOLD }})
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}"

# pr-738: gh-737 pack PR template must emit 'Closes # issue ' (merge bot can't link factory PRs) ## Description Closes #737 ### What changed Added a shared `ensureClosesLine`/`extractIssueNumber` guard in `js/common/pullRequest.js` that injects the canonical `Closes #N` line (N = trailing number of the ticket key, e.g. `gh-737` → 737) into every PR body by construction, and threaded a new `ticketKey` option through `createPullRequest` and all PR-creating pack actions (`developTicketAndCreatePR`, `developBugFixBatchAndCreatePR`, `postTestAutomationResults`, `postStoryTestAutomationResults`, `postMobileTestAutomationResults`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `postTestReworkResults`, direct `scm.createPr` in `preCliTestReworkSetup`). ### Key decisions - Single choke point: injection lives in `common/pullRequest.js`, so both the gh-cli and SCM-provider paths are covered — `developBugAndCreatePR` inherits it via delegation, no change needed there - Idempotent: a body that already contains `Closes #N` for the same issue is untouched; non-canonical keywords (`Fixes`/`Part-of`, accepted bot-side via awf#19) never substitute — the pack still emits canonical `Closes` - Applied after body resolution, so even the `defaultBody` fallback (`'Development changes.'`) carries the line; keys without digits leave the body unchanged - TDD: failing tests first — helper-level cases (prepend/idempotent/Fixes-still-gets-Closes/no-digits/gh-cli/SCM/back-compat) plus an end-to-end dev-leg test asserting the written PR body contains `Closes #737` ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json ``` 1597 passed, 0 failed (includes the new gh-737 suites).
Architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD DEV[developTicketAndCreatePR] --> PRH[common/pullRequest.js] BUG[developBugAndCreatePR] -->|delegates| DEV TA[postTestAutomationResults
postStory/MobileTestAutomationResults] --> PRH TREV[prepareTestPRForReview
postTestReworkResults] --> PRH TRW[preCliTestReworkSetup] -->|ensureClosesLine| BODY PRH --> CLOSES[ensureClosesLine
gh-737 → Closes #737] CLOSES --> BODY[PR body] --> BOT[awf factory-merge-trigger
links PR to issue] ```

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: crap4js gate (ratchet — baseline ${{ env.CRAP_THRESHOLD }})
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}"

- **Note on merge state** — the session started mid-merge of `origin/main` (gh-738 fix forwarding `ciRunUrl`, conflicted file `js/redirectToRepoAgent.js`, already resolved). The resolved content is preserved in the working tree; no merge content was lost (the merge brought only that one file's change).
- Threads 3 (APPROVE summary) and 4 (orchestration note) are top-level comments, not actionable review threads — no code change required.

## Approach

1. **Thread 1** — restored the lost newline; the test declaration and `var writes = [];` are on separate lines again.
2. **Thread 2 (TDD: RED → GREEN)**:
   - **RED**: added `js/unit-tests/test_preCliTestReworkSetup.js` (registered in `js/unit-tests/run_all.json`) with 3 tests against the real `common/pullRequest.js` helper behind a spy wrapper: (a) PR creation routes through `prHelper.createPullRequest` **with** `ticketKey`, (b) the resulting PR body carries `Closes #737` by construction, (c) the module never hand-applies `ensureClosesLine`.    - **GREEN**: replaced the raw `scm.createPr` call in `preCliTestReworkSetup.js` with `prHelper.createPullRequest({ ..., ticketKey, bodyContent, workingDir, scm })`. # pr-738: gh-737 pack PR template must emit 'Closes # issue ' (merge bot can't link factory PRs) ## Description Closes #737 ### What changed Added a shared `ensureClosesLine`/`extractIssueNumber` guard in `js/common/pullRequest.js` that injects the canonical `Closes #N` line (N = trailing number of the ticket key, e.g. `gh-737` → 737) into every PR body by construction, and threaded a new `ticketKey` option through `createPullRequest` and all PR-creating pack actions (`developTicketAndCreatePR`, `developBugFixBatchAndCreatePR`, `postTestAutomationResults`, `postStoryTestAutomationResults`, `postMobileTestAutomationResults`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `postTestReworkResults`, direct `scm.createPr` in `preCliTestReworkSetup`). ### Key decisions - Single choke point: injection lives in `common/pullRequest.js`, so both the gh-cli and SCM-provider paths are covered — `developBugAndCreatePR` inherits it via delegation, no change needed there - Idempotent: a body that already contains `Closes #N` for the same issue is untouched; non-canonical keywords (`Fixes`/`Part-of`, accepted bot-side via awf#19) never substitute — the pack still emits canonical `Closes` - Applied after body resolution, so even the `defaultBody` fallback (`'Development changes.'`) carries the line; keys without digits leave the body unchanged - TDD: failing tests first — helper-level cases (prepend/idempotent/Fixes-still-gets-Closes/no-digits/gh-cli/SCM/back-compat) plus an end-to-end dev-leg test asserting the written PR body contains `Closes #737` ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json ``` 1597 passed, 0 failed (includes the new gh-737 suites).

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner

        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: crap4js gate (ratchet — baseline ${{ env.CRAP_THRESHOLD }})
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}"

Rework complete. Summary of what was done:

## Both open review threads addressed

**Thread 1 — formatting regression** (`js/unit-tests/test_pullRequestHelper.js`): restored the lost newline so `test('truncates oversized PR body...', function() {` and `var writes = [];` are on separate lines again.

**Thread 2 — choke-point bypass** (`js/preCliTestReworkSetup.js`): replaced the raw `scm.createPr` call + hand-applied `ensureClosesLine` with a single `prHelper.createPullRequest({ ..., ticketKey, bodyContent, workingDir, scm })` call, so the `Closes #N` guarantee lives in exactly one place. Behavior is identical (helper covers SCM-provider and gh-cli paths).

## TDD evidence

- **RED first**: new suite `js/unit-tests/test_preCliTestReworkSetup.js` (registered in `run_all.json`) with the real `common/pullRequest.js` behind a spy — 2 of 3 tests failed pre-fix (0 `createPullRequest` calls; 1 direct `ensureClosesLine` call).
- **GREEN**: all 3 pass post-fix — routes through the helper with `ticketKey`, body carries `Closes #737` by construction, no bypass.
- **No regressions**: full suite A/B'd against the pre-change baseline via `git stash` — failure set byte-identical (48 pre-existing node-harness mock gaps, unrelated). Targeted re-run: 24/24 pass.

## Notes

- The session started mid-merge of `origin/main` (gh-738 `ciRunUrl` fix, `redirectToRepoAgent.js` already resolved). `git stash` dropped the `MERGE_HEAD` state, but the resolved content is fully preserved in the working tree — the merge brought only that one file, nothing was lost.
- Threads 3 (APPROVE) and 4 (orchestration note) are top-level comments, not actionable threads.
